events.title: Murray Hill – Showbiz! The Tour
events.summary: Experience a unique blend of cabaret, stand-up, and storytelling with comedian Murray Hill. Celebrating his debut memoir, this show features razor-sharp wit, ad-libbing, and heartfelt wisdom, backed by his swinging live band, THE BALONEY SANDWICHES, for a full-throttle spectacle.

evidence.description: My Life as a Middle-Aged Man, comedian Murray Hill hits the road with a one-of-a-kind show that is part cabaret, part stand-up, and part behind-the-curtain tell-all.
